title: Release
description: Data model for a release in a statistical production process.

event_id.description: Stable identifier of this persisted release event.

recorded_at.description: Timezone-aware instant when this release event was recorded.

git_dirty.description: Whether staged, unstaged, or untracked non-ignored changes existed at release. Null means unknown.

git_repository.description: Repository name or sanitized URI containing code and version-controlled configuration.

producer_metadata.description: Team-defined JSON-compatible release details; cannot override named fields.

dapla_team.description: Name of the dapla team that produced the release.

statistics_name.description: Statistics shortname or statistics product name

git_commit_hash.description: Git commit hash for the release.

data_source.description: Released GCS paths with generations or inline partition members, used to discover producing lineage segments.
data_source.$comment: Dataset filepath (eg. GCS-path to a parquet file).

daplalab_image.description: The tag of the Daplalab container image that produced the release.
